title: deputyOS hook payload schemas
description: JSON Schemas for the four hook kinds documented in docs/11-roadmap.md §M7. Hook scripts under /etc/deputyos/hooks.d/<kind>/ receive one of these payloads on stdin (compact JSON, one object). The dispatcher kills any script that runs longer than 5 seconds and never propagates a non-zero exit to the calling code path; failures are logged with the script name, exit code, and a tail of stderr. See deputyctl/src/hooks.rs and deputyctl/src/message_relay.rs for the firing path.

pre-message.title: pre-message hook payload
pre-message.description: Fired by the agent (via the relay) before a user message is sent to the model. Hooks may short-circuit by exiting non-zero (the agent decides whether to honour that — deputyOS does not enforce blocking semantics; hooks are advisory).

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp at which the agent received the message.

channel.description: Source channel id (e.g. Slack channel id, web session id, CLI 'tty').

user_id.description: Stable identifier for the message author within the channel.

message.description: Raw message text, before any redaction or templating.

post-message.title: post-message hook payload
post-message.description: Fired by the agent (via the relay) after a model response has been delivered to the user. Carries cost / latency telemetry; cost-alert hooks consume a separate kind.

duration_ms.description: Wall-clock ms from request to final-token delivery.

tokens.description: Provider-reported token accounting; absent if the provider does not return it.

cost_usd.description: Computed USD cost; deputyOS uses the provider's published pricing.

cost-alert.title: cost-alert hook payload
cost-alert.description: Fired by `cost::evaluate` (Lane M5) when a configured budget threshold is crossed. The threshold model and emission cadence are documented in docs/11-roadmap.md §M5.

threshold_usd.description: Budget that triggered the alert (e.g. daily cap).

spent_usd.description: Cumulative USD spent in the current window when the alert fired.

window.description: Aggregation window the threshold applies to.

update-applied.title: update-applied hook payload
update-applied.description: Fired by `update::run_apply` after the staged image has been verified against the signed manifest. The A/B swap itself happens later (M6); this hook fires on the staging step so admin tooling can refresh dashboards / send notifications eagerly.

staged_at.description: Absolute path of the staged artefact on this host.

release_version.description: Y.M.D release identifier from the signed manifest.
